cs.t: I'm a Linux guy for two decades and all the hardware accessories I buy are from Microsoft - keyboards, mice, webcams, joysticks etc. I did do Logitech for a while, but they were incredibly user hostile - for example they didn't have drivers available for download, at one point wanted to charge for them, and then the final straw was a driver for a USB keyboard that refused to install on the grounds that I was pirating the driver! I detest the constant assumption in Windows that you are a vile thief stealing it, but the hardware accessories have been the other way around.  Drivers always available, always worked, and even available for Mac.  And on Linux the hardware has just worked out of the box.
cs.th: The end of the road for OEMs
